justification: A is a low-relief panel crowded with multiple distinct creatures — quadrupeds/birds in profile, a row of repeated arched signs, a band of zigzag/hatched pattern and a plant-like frond — while B is a single free-standing three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure with a massive head, brow ridge, nose, ears and arms with hands converging on the belly. The only real correspondence is the very generic one of schematic, blocky, low-detail figuration on a monolithic upright stone; there is no shared specific motif, no shared relationship between elements, and no comparable compositional scheme.
